name: RetroWeird Logo Designs
descriptions: Here are some words to test.

This design was a follow-along with my professor for the class.  It is not particularly my style or what I would have designed myself, but it was used by our professor to show us tools and techniques in Adobe Illustrator.
Here are some words to test with the joystick logo.
descriptionbase: These designs were for an Intro to Digital Media Design class I took.  We were supposed to design a few logos for the fictional company 'RetroWeird Software', in line with the company brief we were given: 'The purpose of RetroWeird Software is to create and distribute modern video games that have a retro feel. Modern gaming could include VR and online multiplayer games.'

name: RetroWeird Website Mockup
descriptions: For my mockup, I used the Gutenberg Diagram to choose the layout for my website.
descriptionbase: This design was for my Intro to Digital Media Design class.  We had to create a mockup in Adobe Photoshop for a website homepage for the fictional company 'RetroWeird Software'.  We had to use our favorite logo from our previous assignment as well as follow a specific color scheme and choose to use either a Z-layout, F-layout, or Gutenberg Diagram.

name: MU Quizbowl Logo Designs
descriptions: This logo I made to replace the current one we were using on our social media sites and university page.
This design was made as a potential sticker, taking inspiration from a whiteboard doodle another club-member made during a practice.
This design was used our final sticker design, hence the shape.
This was another potential sticker design I made, but wasn't ultimately voted for by club members.
descriptionbase: I am a member of Mizzou's Quiz Bowl team, and am currently the club treasurer and social media manager.  As part of my involvement with the club, I decided to remake the club logo as well as make designs for stickers.  In doing so, I made a lot of variations of similar designs, and these are a select few.

name: TeePublic Art
descriptions: I'm including this as a sample of my other art, although because I base a lot of my designs on references to tv shows and various media, I can't always guarantee that they'll always be 'safe for work' (never anything egregious, at most probably swearing), although they are at the moment.
descriptionbase: In my free time, I create designs for some of my interests.  I then upload these designs to the website TeePublic to sell on t-shirts, stickers, coffee mugs, etc.
